title: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 52
summary: Sangat is carried here from siree Raag, Fifth Mehla: toward may I never forget You, Lord. This soul, body and breath are Yours.
whyItMatters: This shabad is useful when life feels isolated, impressionable, needing-company, because it keeps sangat inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private mood.
takeaway: Sangat steadies when may I never forget You, Lord. This soul, body and breath are Yours.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur paramesur poojeeaai man tan lai piaar ||
lines.translation: Worship the Guru, the Transcendent Lord, with your mind and body attuned to love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur dhaataa jeea kaa sabhasai dhei adhaar ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the Giver of the soul; He gives Support to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਸਚਾ ਏਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bachan kamaavane sachaa eh veechaar ||
lines.translation: Act according to the Instructions of the True Guru; this is the true philosophy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bin saadhoo sa(n)gat ratiaa maiaa moh sabh chhaar ||1||
lines.translation: Without being attuned to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all attachment to Maya is just dust. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere saajan har har naam samaal ||
lines.translation: O my friend, reflect upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)gat man vasai pooran hovai ghaal ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: . In the Saadh Sangat, He dwells within the mind, and one's works are brought to perfect fruition. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur samarath apaar gur vaddabhaagee dharasan hoi ||
lines.translation: The Guru is All-powerful, the Guru is Infinite. By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur agochar niramalaa gur jevadd avar na koi ||
lines.translation: The Guru is Imperceptible, Immaculate and Pure. There is no other as great as the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur karataa gur karanahaar gurmukh sachee soi ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Creator, the Guru is the Doer. The Gurmukh obtains true glory.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur te baahar kichh nahee gur keetaa loRe su hoi ||2||
lines.translation: Nothing is beyond the Guru; whatever He wishes comes to pass. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur teerath gur paarajaat gur manasaa pooranahaar ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Sacred Shrine of Pilgrimage, the Guru is the Wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur dhaataa har naam dhei udharai sabh sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Fulfiller of the desires of the mind. The Guru is the Giver of the Name of the Lord, by which all the world is saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur samarath gur nira(n)kaar gur uoochaa agam apaar ||
lines.translation: The Guru is All-powerful, the Guru is Formless; the Guru is Lofty, Inaccessible and Infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੇ ਕਥਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee mahimaa agam hai kiaa kathe kathanahaar ||3||
lines.translation: The Praise of the Guru is so sublime-what can any speaker say? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੜੇ ਫਲ ਮਨਿ ਬਾਛੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਤੜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jitaRe fal man baachhe'eeh titaRe satigur paas ||
lines.translation: All the rewards which the mind desires are with the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਪਾਵਣੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorab likhe paavane saach naam dhe raas ||
lines.translation: One whose destiny is so pre-ordained, obtains the Wealth of the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆਂ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur saranee aaiaa(n) baahuR nahee binaas ||
lines.translation: Entering the Sanctuary of the True Guru, you shall never die again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੯੯॥
lines.transliteration: har naanak kadhe na visarau eh jeeau pi(n)dd teraa saas ||4||29||99||
lines.translation: Nanak: may I never forget You, Lord. This soul, body and breath are Yours. ||4||29||99||

structure: The opening movement names the pressure directly: siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:.
The middle movement deepens the correction by holding the mind inside the Guru is the Creator, the Guru is the Doer. The Gurmukh obtains true.
The closing movement leaves a return you can actually keep: may I never forget You, Lord. This soul, body and breath are Yours.
